# .gitleaksignore — allowlist for false-positive gitleaks findings in this repo.
#
# Format: one fingerprint per line. A line starting with `#` is a comment.
# Use `gitleaks detect --source .` to regenerate after rule updates.
#
# 2026-08-13 — Phase 3 exit (advance-phase): gitleaks `generic-api-key`
# rule flagged the YAML `key:` field of a Phase 3 lesson file at
# `.methodology/lessons/01db5fa7e924.md:2`. The value is the lesson's own
# 12-hex-char identifier (the same as the filename stem), not a credential
# — but gitleaks' generic entropy-based rule can't tell the difference.
# Allowlist the file (line 2 is the only secret-shaped token in it).
bfa25ee7a421060b132b4bfd5917298fc340f17e:.methodology/lessons/01db5fa7e924.md:generic-api-key:2

mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
[mutmut]
# Mutation test scope — must match the SAB's nfr_traceability[NFR-08]
# scope_layers (service, repository). The framework checks setup.cfg
# against the SAB at finalize time and BLOCKS on disagreement.
paths_to_mutate = 03-development/src/taskq_api/repository, 03-development/src/taskq_api/service
# Drop async tests from the mutmut baseline — mutmut 2.x does not natively
# run ``async def`` tests, and the framework's workdir isolation strips
# the project's pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] asyncio_mode,
# so async tests cannot be exercised as a baseline. Filter them out of
# the runner so the baseline is not crashed by collected-async-tests
# that all "fail" with "async def functions are not natively supported".
runner = /Users/johnny/projects/taskq-api/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -k "not asyncio" --tb=no -q -p no:cacheprovider

[tool:pytest]
# Mirror pyproject.toml so the framework's workdir pytest picks up
# asyncio_mode (the workdir has no pyproject.toml; only setup.cfg survives).
asyncio_mode = auto
testpaths = 03-development/tests
pythonpath = 03-development/src

test_coverage::pyproject.toml.head:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "taskq-api"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "HTTP task-queue service (taskq-api round 2/3 test-bed)"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
# Phase 3 will flesh this out — only the manifest's PRESENCE unlocks
# `run-env-check` so P3's per-FR TDD can install deps. Agent A in P3 owns
# the dep list (Pydantic models, SQLAlchemy 2.x, Alembic, FastAPI,
# uvicorn, httpx, import-linter for NFR-06, ... per SAD.md / SPEC.md).
dependencies = [
    "hypothesis>=6.165",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = []
